about.bio: Information Systems graduate seeking a Junior Full-Stack Web Developer position, focusing on C# development alongside frontend experience in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind. Experienced in reading codebases comprehensively to diagnose issues contextually, I leverage AI-assisted tools for debugging and automated testing while maintaining a strict habit of utilizing Git and GitHub pipelines for continuous project backup, supported by foundational Cisco training in secure networking concepts.

skills.name: React Frame Core
skills.description: React is a popular, open-source JavaScript library developed by Meta for building user interfaces, specifically for single-page applications. It allows developers to create reusable UI components and efficiently manages application states using a virtual DOM.

skills.name: TypeScript Typing
skills.description: TypeScript is a free, open-source programming language developed by Microsoft that builds on JavaScript by adding static type definitions. It acts as a strict syntactical superset of JavaScript, meaning all valid JavaScript code is also valid TypeScript. The TypeScript compiler checked code for errors before deploying, which helps developers catch bugs early during development.

skills.name: Tailwind Grid Layouts
skills.description: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework designed for rapid UI development. Instead of writing custom CSS files or using pre-built components, you style elements by applying pre-defined utility classes directly into your HTML or JSX structure.

skills.name: C#
skills.description: C# (C-Sharp) is a modern, object-oriented programming language developed by Microsoft and powered by the .NET framework. It is used to build cross-platform desktop, web, and mobile apps, as well as 3D video games using the Unity engine.

skills.name: HTML
skills.description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard markup language used to create and structure content on the web. It acts as the skeleton of any website, defining elements like headings, paragraphs, links, and images.

skills.name: CSS
skills.description: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is the language used to style and layout webpages. While HTML creates the structure, CSS controls the visual presentation, including colors, fonts, spacing, and responsive layouts.

skills.name: PostgreSQL
skills.description: PostgreSQL is an advanced, open-source object-relational database management system (RDBMS). It uses SQL to safely store and scale complex data workloads.

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its clear syntax and readability. It is widely used for web development, data science, artificial intelligence, and automation.

skills.name: JavaScript
skills.description: JavaScript is a high-level, interpreted programming language that powers dynamic behavior on webpages. Alongside HTML and CSS, it is a core technology of the World Wide Web, running natively inside web browsers.
